name: Birth of Napoleon Bonaparte
description: Napoleon Bonaparte is born in Corsica, to father Carlo Buonaparte and mother Letizia Ramolino.

name: Napoleon attends military school in Brienne-le-Château
description: Napoleon begins his preparatory education at the College of Autun before moving to the Military School in Brienne-le-Château.

name: Napoleon enrolls in École Militaire, Paris
description: Napoleon enrolls at École Militaire in Paris for a year of advanced training.

name: Debut as an officer
description: Napoleon starts his military career as a second lieutenant in an artillery regiment.

name: French Revolution begins
description: French Revolution begins. Napoleon aligns himself with the Jacobins, a revolutionary political club.

name: Siege of Toulon
description: Napoleon, now captain, helps to capture the city of Toulon from the British, which earns him a rank of Brigadier General.

name: Imprisonment
description: Napoleon is arrested and briefly imprisoned due to his association with the Robespierre brothers.

name: Marriage to Josephine
description: Napoleon marries Josephine de Beauharnais and they form a political and personal partnership.

name: Italian Campaign
description: Napoleon conducts a successful campaign in Italy, earning him fame and a reputation as a military genius.

name: French Invasion of Egypt
description: Napoleon launches an expedition to Egypt to undermine Britain's access to India.

name: Coup of 18 Brumaire
description: Napoleon orchestrates the coup, effectively ending the French Revolution and setting himself up as a dictator.

name: Napoleon as First Consul
description: Napoleon becomes First Consul of France, making him the country's de facto leader.

name: Napoleon becomes Life Consul
description: After a questionable plebiscite, Napoleon's rule as Life Consul is ratified, giving him absolute power for life.

name: Sale of Louisiana
description: Napoleon sells the Louisiana territory to the United States of America.

name: Coronation of Napoleon
description: Napoleon crowns himself Emperor, solidifying his rule.

name: Battle of Austerlitz
description: One of Napoleon's greatest victories where he defeats a Russo-Austrian army.

name: Peninsular War
description: In an attempt to enforce the Continental System, Napoleon invades Portugal, initiating the Peninsular War.

name: Napoleon divorces Josephine
description: Napoleon divorces Josephine due to her inability to bear him an heir.

name: Marriage to Marie Louise
description: Napoleon marries Austrian princess Marie Louise, ensuring a powerful alliance and an heir to his empire.

name: Birth of Napoleon's Heir, Napoleón François
description: Napoleon's son, Napoleón François, is born, securing an heir to his empire.

name: Invasion of Russia
description: Napoleon mounts an ill-fated invasion of Russia, a disastrous endeavor that significantly weakens his hold on power.

name: Battle of Leipzig
description: Napoleon is defeated at this major battle and is forced to retreat to France.

name: First Exile
description: After being forced to abdicate, Napoleon is exiled to the island of Elba.

name: Escape from Elba and the Hundred Days
description: Napoleon returns to France, regains power, reigns for Hundred Days before being defeated at Waterloo.

name: Waterloo
description: Napoleon's attempt to secure his rule ends in defeat at the Battle of Waterloo.

name: Second Exile
description: After Waterloo, Napoleon is exiled to the remote island of Saint Helena in the South Atlantic Ocean.

name: Death of Napoleon Bonaparte
description: Napoleon breeds his last in exile on Saint Helena. The cause of death is officially stated as stomach cancer, but some speculate about possible poisoning.
